subject: Increasing time for building and compiling identical model in for loop

messages.author: 73b37a8108370eea
messages.subject: Increasing time for building and compiling identical model in for loop
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am testing different things to try to optimize the running (and model building and compilation) time of a lenghty CMR model. I am simulating very small toy datasets and to be sure that I got a relatively reliable estimate of computing time with every modification I make to the model code, I re-simulate data and analyze it with the same model 10 times using a for-loop. However, I find that the time to build the model and to compile it increases (a lot) with every new iteration of the loop. I wonder if that is a normal behavior (I doubt it) or if theres something that I'm doing wrong (seems more likely).

the for loop basically does the following:


for(it in 1:n.reps){

[... some code to simulate data and info to feed to nimble...]

  start.def<-Sys.time()

  gsg.mod<-nimbleModel(code = myCode,
                       data = myData,
                       constants = myConstants,
                       inits = the_inits(),
                       calculate=F)
 
  conf <- configureMCMC(gsg.mod,monitors=myParameters, useConjugacy = T)
 
  start.build<-Sys.time()
  gsg.MCMC <- buildMCMC(conf)
 
  #Compile model and MCMC
  start.compile<-Sys.time()
  C.gsg.mod<-compileNimble(gsg.mod)
 
  Cgsg.MCMC <- compileNimble(gsg.MCMC, project=gsg.mod)
 
  start.MCMC<-Sys.time()
  results<-runMCMC(Cgsg.MCMC, niter = niter, nburnin = nburnin, thin = thin, nchains = 3, progressBar = T)
  finished<-Sys.time()

#Compute time for each step
definition<-start.build-start.def
  building<-start.compile-start.build
  compilation<-start.MCMC-start.compile
  chain.runs<-finished-start.MCMC
  total.run<-finished-start.def

#Store running time info 
  time_run[it,]<- c(definition, building, compilation, chain.runs, total.run)

} #End for it in n.reps

I have attached the table with the computing times. Basically compilation takes 8X more time at the 10th iteration than at the first, which is unfortunate since its then not really telling me how much the optimization improved overall time required to run models.

I can also provide the entire code if needed.

Thanks for the help!

Fred L

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: Increasing time for building and compiling identical model in for loop
parts:
Frédéric, thanks for articulating the problem you're seeing, and also attaching the results and example code.

This can be a known problem with building and compiling many objects using nimble, and there are a few strategies that I hope you can try using, which might help.  Several of these options are described in Sections 15.9 and 15.10 of the Nimble User Manual.

To remove compiled objects from memory and unload the shared libraries, nimble provides nimble:::clearCompiled().  You might try adding this right before the end of your for loop:

nimble:::clearCompiled(C.gsg.mod)
nimble:::clearCompiled(Cgsg.MCMC)

Furthermore, to remove any remaining (and potentially large) objects from R memory, and to force the deallocation of any memory associated, you might try removing these objects (the model and MCMC objects, and the MCMC "results" object) from the R workspace, and then calling R's garbage collector to release the memory (gc()), so something like this at the end of your loop:

rm(gsg.mod, conf, gsg.MCMC, C.gsg.mod, Cgsg.MCMC, results)
gc()

Finally, there's also the option of nimbleOptions(clearNimbleFunctionsAfterCompiling = TRUE), described in Section 15.10, although I'm not sure this would have much effect beyond what is described above.  Also, it's still marked as "experimental" and is not extensively used or vetted.

I'll also mention, that purely for what your code above is doing, there would be no need to rebuild the model and the MCMC, and recompile each of these new objects, but rather the same compiled MCMC could be reused repeatedly.  But I understand the purpose of your code is more to obtain reliable benchmarks for the timing of each step.

Hope this helps, good luck,
Daniel

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: Increasing time for building and compiling identical model in for loop
parts:
Myy mistake, here because the compiled model and the compiled MCMC objects are both part of the same nimbleProject, you need only clear the compiled objects for one of them (and, the second call on an object from the same project gives the error message that you're seeing).  So, use only *one* of:

nimble:::clearCompiled(C.gsg.mod), or
nimble:::clearCompiled(Cgsg.MCMC),

but using both will give the error you're seeing.  As you noted, these are not well documented.

Good luck, and let me know if it helps with the timing.

Cheers,
Daniel
